1.why: Text uses a clean sans-serif typeface with ample line height and uncrowded layout, though letter spacing looks close to default rather than distinctly widened.

2.why: All headings, labels, and instructions appear in sentence or title case with no italics, all-caps text, or dense paragraphs on any screen.

3.why: The interface is a single narrow column with large tap targets and clear spacing, so all content stays readable at mobile width.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Get a six-digit identity code for this demo' and 'Take as long as you need' are short, plain, and jargon-free.

5.why: The email field shows the placeholder 'name@example.com' and the code field shows '123456', giving a clear example of the expected input.

6.why: Each screen presents at most a couple of short sentences before the action button, so no long block of text must be read to proceed.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control appears anywhere and the activity log says the code is shown only in the browser console, so the six digits must be typed by hand.

8.why: None of the five screenshots offers a QR code or any scannable equivalent; manual entry of the digits is the only visible option.

9.why: The login uses standard email/password inputs that password managers could fill, but nothing visible (such as one-time-code support on the code field) confirms autofill support, so this cannot be verified from the screenshots.

10.why: The filled segment of the four-part progress bar plus an iconed heading mark the current step, and the solid full-width blue button makes the primary action unmistakable.

11.why: Every screen has exactly one solid primary button, with auxiliary options like 'Re-request identity code' and 'Need help?' clearly styled as secondary.

12.why: Green status banners such as 'Signed in successfully. Next: get your identity code.' plainly state what happened and what comes next, reinforced by the activity log.

13.why: The user can retry 'Check code' and re-request a new code with no shown penalty, though no reveal or hide control for codes is provided.

14.why: The error 'That code does not match. Check the six digits, or request a new code.' names the problem and two fixes in neutral language without blaming the user.

15.why: The flow explicitly states 'There is no reading timer. Take as long as you need.' and no countdown or expiry indicator appears on any screen.
